svg.text: TENGU RIDGE - PARTIAL TERRAIN AND INACTIVE ACCESS STUDY
Authored glade on existing Khusha relief; no registered village, flat building pad, tunnel or WN gate.
Natural slope retained; no whole-village flattening.
Original route: 364.5 blocks; natural grade up to 0.612.
Both endpoints fail the registered-site contract.
No graded route is exported; no walking test claimed.
Official episode 64: Khusha residence and later tunnel.
Summit detail remains wiki-level; exact parcel is ours.
Initial buildings/roster and full terraces remain open.
Natural surface along the INACTIVE proposal - not a constructed stair profile
The surface proposal remains separate from later tunnel diplomacy and the WN barrier-gate setting.
